qmmm.help: Executes qmmm calculations for individual molecules and clusters

print_regions_pdb.help: print the geometry of the regions to a pdb file

max_iterations.help: max iterations for qmmm scf loop

job_file.help: name of jobfile to which jobs are written

states.help: states to write jobs for and which to parse from jobfile

segments.help: segments to write jobs for and which to parse from jobfile

use_gs_for_ex.help: If true uses the ground state geometry for excited states

regions.help: Definitions of all regions inside qmmmm

qmregion.help: qmregion with dft and optionally gwbse

state.help: initial state to track or ground state for dftcalculations

compute_forces.help: after the inter-region loop has converged, compute the analytic forces on the QM atoms of the tracked state (DFT ground state, charged e/h states, BSE singlets/triplets and perturbative QP levels with GW-BSE) with the environment at its converged moments, and write them to the job output (Hartree/Bohr). For the iterative scheme these are the derivatives of the QM/MM energy when the environment is converged against the density the energy responds to: the ground-state density, or for excited states the relaxed density (set relaxed_density true). xtp DFT package with an auxiliary basis; not with environment_screening, DFT-in-DFT or an Ewald region

relaxed_density.help: polarize the polar regions with the relaxed density of the tracked state (orbital relaxation and, for G0W0/evGW with sigma_integrator ppm or exact, the response of the QP corrections; DFTEngine::RelaxedDensityMatrix) instead of the unrelaxed one; for BSE singlets/triplets and perturbative QP levels, xtp DFT package with an auxiliary basis, closed shell, no environment_screening or DFT-in-DFT

environment_screening.help: screen GW-BSE by the polar regions instead of iterating them against the excitation

include_kreac.help: include the reaction field of the transition density in the BSE (linear-response part, moves bright singlets)

shell_regions.help: ids of polar regions that respond as an uncoupled shell with polarizability alpha/shell_dielectric (legacy radial_dielectric) instead of as a coupled Thole system; empty for none

shell_dielectric.help: dielectric constant that stands in for the mutual induction the shell leaves out

site_width.help: width of the polar sites seen by the QM density, in units of alpha^(1/3): each site responds to the QM field averaged over a Gaussian of that width, which keeps point dipoles inside the tails of diffuse auxiliary functions from over-screening; 0 for point sites

grid_for_potential.help: Grid to integrate influence of qm density om other regions

extgrid.help: grid on which the interaction with classical regions is compute

tolerance_energy.help: if energy difference for this region is below this value it is considered converged

tolerance_density.help: if the RMS change of the density matrix is below this value it is considered converged; measured in the Loewdin-orthonormalised basis (S^1/2 dD S^1/2), where near-linear dependencies of the AO basis do not inflate it

tolerance_density_max.help: if the largest change of a density-matrix element is below this value it is considered converged; measured in the Loewdin-orthonormalised basis. The largest element change is typically tens of times the RMS change, so this is looser than tolerance_density

polarregion.help: polar region with polarisation dipoles and thole damping

ewaldregion.help: periodic Ewald background read from an ewaldbackground checkpoint

id.help: id of the region, first region has to have id 0, ids must be consecutive

checkpoint.help: checkpoint file written by the ewaldbackground calculator
